name: Orientation

entrances.note: the elevator on the north wall opens (closed, half, open) and the avatar steps out onto the LIFT mat
arrival from the Records entrance door

exits.locked_sign: RECORDS: Orientation seal required. The garden route back to the elevator stays lit.
exits.note: the sliding glass door at x26-27, y5-7; walkable once level 06 is complete

elevator.note: north wall, west end: a 3x3 module at x2-4 (wall rows 0-1, LIFT mat row y2); the car is the centre cell (3,1). The call panel at x5 opens the elevator map with Interact (Return); it only lists unlocked stops.

light_states.description: The north task light stops pulsing and holds steady.
The left desk lamp wakes and the corridor stripe beside it lights together.
The right desk gets its warmer lamp and its corridor stripe.
Garden lamps wake to the wider pulse glow, coral blooms appear, the cut-through opens along column x12 and the seating nook is revealed.

ambient: Air handling, shoes on stone, garden water, distant conversations. Printer and garden lamps wake; synchronized worker loops break into individual idle poses.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Type five plant labels on five duplicated planters, with ordinary home-row rolls; each label must be exact.
success_criteria: Each of the five labels equals its target
Rolls such as sa, ka, dahl and fl stay literal letters

task.prompt: Plant tag: type the label for this planter.

feedback.other: The observed text is shown above the tag. Try the letters again; nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: Five planters were duplicated overnight and nobody knows which is which. Could you tag each one?
dialogue.cue: Ivo: Plant Tags before the Orientation review: neutral

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: All five tagged. I can finally tell the ferns from the flax.
dialogue.cue: Ivo: Plant Tags before the review: neutral

reward.desk_decoration: planter label for the player's desk
reward.dialogue: Ivo laughs at Plant Tags revisits after the Orientation seal
reward.revisit: after level 06 the cut-through shortens the walk back to Ivo

notes: Hub: the garden loop (bands x8-9, x17-18, y4-5, y12-13) is the one-camera hub. Exits visible from it: the printer (north), the east corridor to the Records door, the mailroom (southeast), the elevator (north-west).

Hub, short branch, task room, changed return route: printer branch (level 02) returns past a steady task light; the north-wall meeting room (03) opens its glass door; the left (04) and right (05) desk branches light their lamps and corridor stripes and change the pinboard beside the arrival; the review table (06) opens the east door and the garden cut-through and reveals the seating nook.

Arrival (north wall, west end) was moved from the south-west by a player decision: it keeps the keyboard inset clear and the first lap starts on the camera's top-left. The first lap is the counter-clockwise loop reached from the LIFT mat: down the west walkway (x3), right along row 12, up column 17, left along row 5.

The garden cut-through is the garden landmark's `after` state (column x12, y7-10, parts `garden_base_open` and `garden_north_rim_open`). The seating nook (`seating_nook_after`, 3x2 at (20,7)) is placed hidden and shown by `ls.garden-wake`; both are in the kit branch feat/art-orientation-completion, so the nook is flagged `art_gap` here until that branch merges.
